newsitem.title: USA: Bank West to buy back 5 pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: Bank West to buy back 5 pct of stock.

text.p: Bank West Financial Corp said Tuesday it expects to repurchase up to 89,000 shares, or 5 percent, of its outstanding common stock.
President and Chief Executive Officer Paul Sydloski said in a statement the buyback is expected to be accretive on a book value and earnings per share basis.
Bank West reported third quarter net income of $253,000, down from $274,000. Sydloski said mortgage loan demand fell from past periods because of increasing market interest rates.
"This fact has overshadowed the accomplishments and progress of our small business development, consumer and wholesale banking operations," he said.
"Although the full benefit of our efforts within these areas have not significantly impacted the current quarters earnings per share, we expect future quarters to reflect our progress."
